title: te taonga i totohu i raro i te whakapehapeha
intro: Whakaarohia te tū i mua i ngā puranga taonga nui rawa atu, ā, mā te mau noa i ngā kī ka ngenge te rōpū tangata kaha. I tō taha, ka akiakihia koe e ngā reo kia ngākau mahaki me te maumahara, engari ka nui ake te kaha o te whakapehapeha i te whakawhetai. He aha te mea ka tupu ina huri te taonga hei whakamātautau, ā, ka hiritia te hua e te whakapehapeha?
clues: Nō te iwi o Mōsa ahau, heoi i hara ahau ki a rātou.
I homai ki ahau he taonga nui whakaharahara, ā, ka taumaha rawa ngā kī ki aua taonga ki tētahi rōpū tangata kaha.
I tohutohungia ahau e tōku iwi kia kaua e whakamanamana, kia rapu hoki i te ao tūroa, me te kore e wareware ki taku wāhi o tēnei ao.
I kī ahau nā te mātauranga anake i homai ai ki ahau ngā mea i a au.
I haereere ahau i mua i tōku iwi me ōku whakapaipai, ā, ko te hunga e hiahia ana ki te ao nei, i hiahia rātou ki te mea rite ki taku.
I horomia ahau e te whenua me tōku whare, ā, kāore he tangata hei āwhina i ahau, kāore hoki i taea e au te āwhina i ahau anō.

trial.label: Whakamātautau/Takahanga
options: I whakamanamana ki te taonga, ā, i whakakahore i te manaakitanga a Allah ahakoa ngā tohutohu
I werohia a Ibrahim mō te homaitanga o te ora me te mate
I ārahi i tētahi ope taua ki a Tāruta rāua ko Rawiri
Ngā whakapakoko whakairo hei karakia mā te iwi
I patua e ia tōna teina i te hae mō te whakahere
trial.answer: I whakamanamana ki te taonga, ā, i whakakahore i te manaakitanga a Allah ahakoa ngā tohutohu

outcome.label: Hua
options: Horomia e te whenua ki te kāinga me te taonga
I toremi i te moana i a ia e whai ana i a Mōsa
I patua ki raro e te kōhatu a Rawiri
I whakangaromia e te pahūtanga nui mō te whakawhāiti i te hope o te kamera uha
I hurihia hei makimaki mō te takahi i te Hāpati
outcome.answer: Horomia e te whenua ki te kāinga me te taonga

arabic: فَخَسَفْنَا بِهِۦ وَبِدَارِهِ ٱلْأَرْضَ فَمَا كَانَ لَهُۥ مِن فِئَةٍۢ يَنصُرُونَهُۥ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمُنتَصِرِينَ
verse: And We caused the earth to swallow him and his home. And there was for him no company to aid him other than Allāh, nor was he of those who [could] defend themselves. (28:81)
